about.title: About Paraysco Consulting Inc.
about.subtitle: Building Sustainable Partnerships • Delivering Professional Excellence • Creating Lasting Value
about.description: Paraysco Consulting Inc. is a multidisciplinary professional consulting firm committed to providing integrated solutions across real estate, engineering, construction, procurement, project management, investment advisory and business consultancy.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.content: To become Africa's leading multidisciplinary consulting and investment facilitation company, delivering world-class professional services that transform businesses, strengthen institutions, develop sustainable infrastructure, and create lasting socio-economic value for future generations.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: To provide innovative, reliable, and integrated consultancy solutions that empower governments, financial institutions, businesses, investors, and communities to achieve sustainable growth through professional excellence, strategic partnerships, and responsible project implementation.

items.integrity: Integrity - We conduct our business honestly, ethically, and transparently.
items.excellence: Professional Excellence - We strive for the highest standards in every assignment through competence and disciplined execution.
items.accountability: Accountability - We take responsibility for our actions, decisions, and performance.
items.innovation: Innovation - We embrace creativity, technology, and continuous improvement.
items.collaboration: Collaboration - We value teamwork and believe that successful outcomes are achieved through meaningful partnerships.
items.sustainability: Sustainability - We support responsible development that balances economic growth with environmental protection.

founder.title: Chairman's Message
founder.name: Mr. Mola Scott
founder.role: Chief Executive Officer, Paraysco Consulting Inc.
founder.message: At Paraysco Consulting Inc., we believe that true development is achieved through visionary leadership, strategic partnerships, professional excellence and unwavering integrity. Our company was established with a clear purpose—to provide innovative consultancy solutions that bridge the gap between ideas and implementation, investment and opportunity, and ambition and sustainable growth. Through innovation, professionalism and collaboration, we aspire to become one of Africa's leading multidisciplinary consulting firms. We remain committed to creating value for our clients, strengthening institutions, supporting sustainable infrastructure development and contributing meaningfully to national and regional economic transformation.

section1.title: Information We Collect
section1.content: Paraysco Consulting Inc. collects information that you provide directly to us, including but not limited to your name, email address, phone number, and any other information you choose to provide when using our services or contacting us through our website.

section2.title: How We Use Your Information
section2.content: We use the information we collect to provide, maintain, and improve our services, to process transactions, to send you information including confirmations and updates, and to respond to your comments, questions, and requests.

section3.title: Information Sharing
section3.content: We do not sell, trade, or otherwise transfer your personally identifiable information to third parties without your consent. This does not include trusted third parties who assist us in operating our website, conducting our business, or servicing you.

section4.title: Data Security
section4.content: We implement a variety of security measures to maintain the safety of your personal information. Your personal information is contained behind secured networks and is only accessible by a limited number of persons who have special access rights.

section5.title: Contact Us
section5.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at parayscoconsulting@gmail.com or through our contact page.

section1.title: Agreement to Terms
section1.content: By accessing or using the Paraysco Consulting Inc. website and services, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our services.

We reserve the right to modify, suspend, or discontinue any part of our services at any time.

section5.content: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Paraysco Consulting Inc. shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages arising from your use of our services.

section6.title: Indemnification

section7.title: Governing Law

section1.title: What Are Cookies
section1.content: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help websites remember your preferences and improve your browsing experience.

section2.title: How We Use Cookies
section2.content: We use cookies to understand how you use our website, remember your preferences, and improve your experience. Cookies help us analyze website traffic and customize content to better serve you.

section3.title: Types of Cookies We Use
section3.content: Essential Cookies: Required for the website to function properly. Performance Cookies: Help us understand how visitors interact with our website. Functionality Cookies: Remember your preferences and settings. Analytics Cookies: Track website usage and performance.

section4.title: Managing Cookies
section4.content: You can control and/or delete cookies as you wish. You can delete all cookies that are already on your computer and you can set most browsers to prevent them from being placed. However, this may cause some features of the website to not work properly.

section5.title: Third-Party Cookies
section5.content: Some cookies on our website may be placed by third-party service providers. These cookies are governed by the privacy policies of these third parties. We encourage you to review the policies of these third parties.
